result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates". The `reports` module compiles. The `-Dtest='*Duplication*'` run printed no errors, but I didn't check that it matched any tests. I haven't generated a real report to look at the section or the "Code" links.

- **Report section:** `DuplicationReportGenerator.java` already had an `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` method that was never called. It builds the section with the description "The list of N most frequently found duplicates." and the same table as Longest Duplicates, and skips the section when there are no such duplicates. I added the call, wrapped in a stopwatch like the other sections.
- **Code fragments:** In `DataExporter.java`, when `saveCodeFragments` is on, the fragments are now also saved as `fragments/most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`. This uses the same method as the longest duplicates and duplicated units.

I left `getReferencedFiles()` in `DataExporter` alone, so the source files of the most frequent duplicates aren't added to its referenced-files set (the longest duplicates' files are). I didn't check what that set affects.
